name: Utah
notes: Utah supports digital ID through the GET Mobile app. Apple Wallet, Google Wallet, and Samsung Wallet are not currently supported.

wallets.name: GET Mobile
steps: Download the GET Mobile app from the App Store or Google Play.
Create or sign in to your Utah DLD account.
Follow the in-app prompts to scan the front and back of your Utah driver's license or ID.
Your digital ID will be available in the app once approved by the Utah DLD.
